Group pulse monitor FDI.mm is a professional group pulse and heart rate monitor app built for group fitness workouts, sports clubs, teams and personal trainers.

Track live group pulse, heart rate zones, and intensity of multiple athletes at the same time. Connect any standard Bluetooth heart rate monitors and display real-time data during every session.

Key Features:
• Group Pulse Monitor - real-time tracking of pulse and heart rate for the entire group
• Group Monitor mode - connect multiple sensors and see all athletes on one screen
• Heart rate monitor & pulse rate monitor with live zones (cardio, fat burn, peak)
• Heart beat monitor with visual intensity indicators
• Multi-Equipment & Fitness Support - connect treadmills, exercise bikes, rowing machines, smart scales, and smart jump ropes via Bluetooth
• Trampoline park & arena support - optimized for trampoline parks and large activity arenas
• Team pulses support - monitor more than 30 athletes simultaneously
• Detailed fitness analytics after every group workout
• Full Bluetooth BLE compatibility with chest straps, armbands, and fitness equipment

Optimize group training, keep athletes in the right zones, and make every session measurable with FDI.mm - the advanced group pulse and heart rate monitor.


FAQ:
Which sensors and fitness equipment are supported?
- All standard Bluetooth (BLE) heart rate monitors and armbands work. The app also supports treadmills, exercise bikes, rowing machines, smart scales, and smart jump ropes that use standard Bluetooth protocols and transmit data via BLE. No proprietary hardware required.

Are different display modes / skins available for heart rate blocks?
- Yes. Pulse monitor of athlete supports 3 display skins: one focused on pulse rate, one centered on workout intensity, and a speedometer layout.

Can I cast the group pulse to a TV?
- Yes. You can use an HDMI adapter or cast wirelessly without adapter. Create a separate screen profile for each TV or information kiosk.

How many athletes can I connect at once?
- You can monitor more than 30 athletes simultaneously. With sensors that support multi-connection protocols, there is virtually no limit. The app also works with specialized USB dongles that increase coverage range.

What is the connection range?
- Up to 50 meters in normal conditions (depends on the sensor and environment). With a compatible USB dongle, the range can reach 100–150 meters.
